class.name: OcgXcafdocColortool
class.brief_description: Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (colors) of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document A Document is intended to hold different attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes Provide tools for management of Colors section of document.
class.description: ! Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (colors) ! of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document ! A Document is intended to hold different ! attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes ! Provide tools for management of Colors section of document.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: returns the label under which colors are stored

method.description: Returns internal XCAFDoc_ShapeTool tool

method.name: IsColor
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to a colortable and is a color definition

method.name: FindColor_3
method.description: Finds a color definition in a colortable and returns its label if found Returns False if color is not found in colortable

method.name: FindColor_4
method.description: Finds a color definition in a colortable and returns its label if found Returns False if color is not found in colortable

method.description: Finds a color definition in a colortable and returns its label if found (or Null label else)

method.name: AddColor_1
method.description: Adds a color definition to a colortable and returns its label (returns existing label if the same color is already defined)

method.name: AddColor_2
method.description: Adds a color definition to a colortable and returns its label (returns existing label if the same color is already defined)

method.name: RemoveColor
method.description: Removes color from the colortable

method.name: GetColors
method.description: Returns a sequence of colors currently stored in the colortable

method.name: SetColor_1
method.description: Sets a link with GUID defined by <type> (see XCAFDoc::ColorRefGUID()) from label <L> to color defined by <colorL>. Color of shape is defined following way in dependance with type of color. If type of color is XCAFDoc_ColorGen - then this color defines default color for surfaces and curves. If for shape color with types XCAFDoc_ColorSurf or XCAFDoc_ColorCurv is specified then such color overrides generic color.

method.name: SetColor_2
method.description: Sets a link with GUID defined by <type> (see XCAFDoc::ColorRefGUID()) from label <L> to color <Color> in the colortable Adds a color as necessary
